body:
Illinois Police Officers’ Pension Investment Fund, Peoria, continued the buildout of its private markets portfolio by approving a $250 million commitment to **TA Realty** Value-Add Fund XIV, its first to a value-added real estate fund.

Get unlimited online stories, daily email alerts and access to P&I Searches and Hires content.

For pension fund boards with delegated investment authority, meeting less frequently can be a better utilization of time for investment staff and board members.

p: 일리노이 경찰공제회(Illinois Police Officers’ Pension Investment Fund, Peoria)는 첫 밸류애드 부동산 펀드 투자로 TA Realty Value-Add Fund XIV에 2억 5,000만 달러 규모의 출자를 승인하며 사모시장 포트폴리오 확대를 이어갔다.
